svg.title: The cdm toolkit for construction data migrations
svg.desc: Profile a raw export in 14 checks, map it to a neutral schema, validate the record files, and reconcile to control totals in 26 checks. Separate commands read and compare schedules, and hash document exports. Standard-library Python, no network.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
